name: lekseis-hover
description: Chrome extension: hover over words in languages you're learning to see meanings, conjugations and declensions.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
scripts.dev: vite build --watch --mode development & vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development; wait
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
